name: Me and My Witches
source:
Ariel is a good witch: she was told not to be "wicked" and therefore never uses her powers - except to dye her hair green and charge her smartphone. 

She'd rather focus on buying crop tops, drinking tequila shots on Friday nights, flirting with Princes with cute hair and writing English Lit essays. 

But one night, Ariel's drink is spiked at a college party.

When she wakes up the next morning, she knows she's been sexually assaulted. But neither the university nor the police seem to want to do anything about it.

With the help of her friends, and of Violet, President of the campus' Feminist Society, Ariel is going to embark on one true investigation to find out whodunnit...

[From [url=https://sophielavergne.itch.io/me-and-my-witches]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱丽儿是一个好女巫：她被告知不要“邪恶”，因此从不使用她的力量——除了把头发染成绿色和给智能手机充电。

她宁愿专注于购买露脐上衣，在周五晚上喝一杯龙舌兰酒，与头发可爱的王子调情，以及写英语文学论文。

但有一天晚上，爱丽儿的饮料在一次大学聚会上被下了毒。

当她第二天早上醒来时，她知道自己遭到了性侵犯。但大学和警方似乎都不想对此采取任何行动。

在她的朋友和校园女权协会主席维奥莱特的帮助下，爱丽儿将开始一项真正的调查，找出凶手……

[来自[url=https://sophielavergne.itch.io/me-and-my-witches]itch.io[/url]]
